---
title: "Activity list"
---

[Training log on Strava](https://www.strava.com/athlete/training){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}

```{r}
#| output: false
library(dplyr)
# Written next to this file by qs_render_index() just before the render. One
# row per activity, already sorted, with href empty where no page exists yet.
m <- readr::read_csv("manifest.csv", show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)
```

```{r}
m |>
  mutate(
    Activity = if_else(
      is.na(.data$href) | .data$href == "",
      .data$name,
      paste0("[", .data$name, "](", .data$href, ")")
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    Date = "date", Activity, Type = "type",
    Distance = "distance", Duration = "duration"
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
